PRD-BOX.description: Complete Box.com integration: OAuth flow testing, document browser UI, Box MCP server setup, and BOM sync validation. Builds on existing OAuth endpoints, Box API client, and BOM sync service.

tasks.title: Validate Box Developer App configuration
tasks.description: Verify the Box Developer Console has the correct redirect URI (http://localhost:5176/api/box/callback), proper scopes (read/write files and folders), and the app is approved. Ensure .env has correct credentials. Test that the OAuth redirect to Box.com works without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Box Developer Console redirect URI matches BOX_REDIRECT_URI in .env
App has necessary Box API scopes enabled
Navigating to /api/box/auth redirects to Box.com login
No errors in server console during redirect

tasks.title: Create 'Inventory & Materials' folder in Box
tasks.description: Ensure the target folder 'Inventory & Materials' exists in the Box.com account. Create a test 'Live Equipment Overview' Excel file inside it with sample BOM columns (Part Number, Name, Description, Category, Manufacturer, Unit Cost, Quantity, Unit of Measure).
acceptanceCriteria: Folder 'Inventory & Materials' exists in Box.com root
File 'Live Equipment Overview' exists inside the folder
Excel file has correct column headers for BOM parsing
At least 3 sample BOM rows with realistic test data

tasks.title: Test full OAuth flow end-to-end
tasks.description: With BOX-001 and BOX-002 complete, test the full OAuth flow: click Connect on settings page -> Box login -> authorize app -> callback stores tokens -> settings shows connected status with folder/file IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page loads at /spu/bom/settings without errors
Clicking 'Connect to Box.com' redirects to Box OAuth
After authorizing, callback redirects to settings with ?connected=true
Folder ID and File ID are displayed on settings page

tasks.title: Test BOM sync from Box.com
tasks.description: With Box connected (BOX-003), test the 'Sync Now' button on settings page. Verify it downloads the Excel file from Box, parses it, and creates bom_item records in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Sync Now' triggers sync without errors
bom_item table has records matching Excel file data
bom_item_version table has 'create' entries for new items
Subsequent syncs show 'update' or no changes as appropriate

tasks.title: Build Box.com document browser page
tasks.description: Create a new page at /spu/documents/box that displays the contents of the 'Inventory & Materials' folder from Box.com. Show files and subfolders in a list/grid with file names, sizes, and types. Allow navigating into subfolders.
acceptanceCriteria: New route at /spu/documents/box with layout integration
Lists files and folders from 'Inventory & Materials'
Shows file name, type icon, and size for each item
Clicking a subfolder navigates into it with breadcrumbs
Shows error state if Box not connected

tasks.title: Setup Box MCP server for AI-assisted content management
tasks.description: Clone and configure the box-community/mcp-server-box for local development. Set up the MCP server with the project's Box OAuth credentials so Claude can interact with Box content directly through MCP tools.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP server .env configured with Box credentials
MCP server starts successfully in STDIO mode
Claude Desktop or Claude Code config updated to use the MCP server
Basic test: can list files via MCP tool
Documentation added to AGENTS.md for MCP server usage

tasks.title: Add file preview/download from Box browser
tasks.description: Extend the Box document browser (BOX-005) to support file preview and download. For Excel/CSV files show a table preview. For other files provide a download link. Use the existing downloadFile() from the box client.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a file opens a detail view or modal
Excel files show first 20 rows in a table preview
Download button works for all file types
API endpoint for file download with access validation
Proper error handling for failed downloads

tasks.title: Add Box connection status to main nav
tasks.description: Add a Box.com connection indicator to the SPU layout sidebar/nav. Show a small icon indicating connected/disconnected status. Link to Box settings page.
acceptanceCriteria: Box status indicator visible in SPU layout nav
Green dot when connected, gray when disconnected
Status loads without blocking page render

tasks.title: Add file upload to Box from webapp
tasks.description: Add file upload capability to the Box document browser. Users can upload files to the current folder (within 'Inventory & Materials' boundary). Use the existing uploadFile() from the box client.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload button visible in Box browser when viewing a folder
File picker allows selecting files from local machine
Upload progress indicator shown during upload
Uploaded file appears in folder listing
Access validation enforced (only within Inventory & Materials)
API endpoint for file upload with proper validation

tasks.title: Add token refresh monitoring and auto-reconnect
tasks.description: Add a server-side check that runs on settings page load to verify the Box token is still valid by calling the Box.com /users/me endpoint. If the token refresh fails, update status to 'disconnected' and show a reconnect prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page load verifies token validity with Box API
If token is expired and refresh fails, status updates to 'disconnected'
UI shows 'Token expired - please reconnect' message
Reconnect button visible when token is invalid
Audit log entry for token expiry events

PRD-WINST.description: Comprehensive document filing system with drag-and-drop upload, automatic parsing of work instructions to extract part numbers and tools, integration with assembly workflow, and version control. Non-work-instruction documents are stored in a document repository.

tasks.title: Add workInstruction table to database schema
tasks.description: Create the core work instruction table for storing parsed work instructions
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'workInstruction' table: id (text PK), documentNumber (text unique, e.g., WIMF-SPU-001), title (text), description (text), documentType (text: 'spu_assembly' | 'general'), status (text: 'draft' | 'active' | 'archived'), currentVersion (integer default 1), originalFileName (text), fileSize (integer), mimeType (text), createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy (FK to user)

tasks.title: Add workInstructionVersion table for version history
tasks.description: Track all versions of work instructions with full content
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'workInstructionVersion' table: id (text PK), workInstructionId (FK), version (integer), content (text - full parsed text), rawContent (text - original file content as base64), changeNotes (text), parsedAt (timestamp), parsedBy (FK to user), createdAt

tasks.title: Add workInstructionStep table for individual steps
tasks.description: Store each step from a work instruction with sequence and content
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'workInstructionStep' table: id (text PK), workInstructionVersionId (FK), stepNumber (integer), title (text), content (text), requiresScan (boolean default false), scanPrompt (text - what to scan), notes (text), createdAt

tasks.title: Add stepPartRequirement table for parts per step
tasks.description: Link parts (PT#) to specific work instruction steps
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'stepPartRequirement' table: id (text PK), stepId (FK to workInstructionStep), partNumber (text - the PT# from document), partDefinitionId (FK to partDefinition, nullable), quantity (integer default 1), notes (text), createdAt

tasks.title: Add stepToolRequirement table for tools per step
tasks.description: Link tools (Tool#) to specific work instruction steps
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'stepToolRequirement' table: id (text PK), stepId (FK to workInstructionStep), toolNumber (text - the Tool# from document), toolName (text), calibrationRequired (boolean default false), notes (text), createdAt

tasks.title: Add documentRepository table for general documents
tasks.description: Store non-work-instruction documents in a general repository
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'documentRepository' table: id (text PK), fileName (text), originalFileName (text), fileSize (integer), mimeType (text), category (text nullable), tags (jsonb), content (text - base64 encoded), description (text), uploadedAt, uploadedBy (FK to user)

tasks.title: Add assemblyStepRecord table for tracking step completion
tasks.description: Record completion of each step during assembly with scanned lot numbers
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'assemblyStepRecord' table: id (text PK), assemblySessionId (FK), workInstructionStepId (FK), scannedLotNumber (text nullable), scannedPartNumber (text nullable), completedAt (timestamp), completedBy (FK to user), signatureId (FK to electronicSignature nullable), notes (text)

tasks.title: Add document and workInstruction permissions to RBAC
tasks.description: Add permission resources for document and work instruction management

tasks.title: Create work instruction parser service

Extract PT# patterns (PT-001, PT#001, Part #001, etc.)
Extract Tool# patterns (Tool-001, Tool #1, T-001, etc.)
Return structured data: { steps: Step[], partsFound: string[], toolsFound: string[] }

PRD-WINSTX.featureName: Work Instruction Custom Fields & Barcode Scanning
PRD-WINSTX.description: Extension to PRD-WINST adding custom configurable scan fields per work instruction step. Fields are populated by scanning external barcodes on parts (containing lot #, part #, expiry, etc.) which link to BOM data.

tasks.title: Add stepFieldDefinition table for custom scan fields
tasks.description: Create table to define custom fields that can be configured per work instruction step (lot, serial, expiry, calibration, etc.)
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'stepFieldDefinition' table: id (text PK), stepId (FK to workInstructionStep), fieldName (text), fieldLabel (text), fieldType (text: 'barcode_scan' | 'manual_entry' | 'date_picker' | 'dropdown'), isRequired (boolean default true), validationPattern (text nullable), options (jsonb nullable for dropdowns), barcodeFieldMapping (text nullable - which GS1 AI to extract), sortOrder (integer default 0), createdAt

tasks.title: Add stepFieldRecord table for captured field values
tasks.description: Store the actual values captured during assembly for each custom field
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'stepFieldRecord' table: id (text PK), assemblyStepRecordId (FK to assemblyStepRecord), stepFieldDefinitionId (FK to stepFieldDefinition), fieldValue (text), rawBarcodeData (text nullable - full scanned barcode), bomItemId (text FK nullable - linked BOM item), scannedAt (timestamp nullable), enteredAt (timestamp nullable), capturedBy (FK to user)

tasks.title: Create barcode parser service for GS1/external codes
tasks.description: Service to parse external barcodes (GS1, QR codes on parts) and extract structured data
acceptanceCriteria: Implement parseGS1Barcode(data): ParsedBarcode - extracts AI fields (01 GTIN, 10 Lot, 17 Expiry, 21 Serial, etc.)
Implement parseQrCode(data): ParsedBarcode - handles QR codes with delimited data
Implement lookupBomItem(lotNumber, partNumber): BomItem | null - finds matching BOM record
Return structured object: { gtin, lotNumber, serialNumber, expiryDate, partNumber, bomItem }

tasks.title: Create custom field configuration UI
tasks.description: UI to configure custom scan fields for each work instruction step
acceptanceCriteria: Display list of steps with their configured fields
Field type selector (barcode scan, manual entry, date picker, dropdown)
For barcode_scan type: select which GS1 AI field to extract (lot, serial, expiry, GTIN)
Drag-and-drop reordering of fields within a step

tasks.title: Create custom field configuration server
tasks.description: Server load and actions for field configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Load work instruction with steps and field definitions

tasks.title: Update assembly step UI for custom fields
tasks.description: Modify assembly UI to display and capture custom fields per step via barcode scanning
acceptanceCriteria: Load custom field definitions for current step
Render appropriate input for each field type (scan input, text input, date picker, dropdown)
For barcode_scan fields: use ScanInput, parse barcode, auto-fill mapped field
Show BOM link status when lot number matches BOM record
Show completed fields with captured values and BOM links

tasks.title: Update assembly server for custom field capture
tasks.description: Server actions to store custom field values and link to BOM
acceptanceCriteria: Load step field definitions with step data
Action 'captureField': parse barcode, validate, store stepFieldRecord
Lookup BOM item by lot number and link if found
Validate all required fields before step completion
Store raw barcode data for traceability
Log audit events for each field capture

tasks.title: Add fields link to work instruction detail page
tasks.description: Add navigation to field configuration from work instruction detail
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Configure Fields' button linking to /fields subpage
Show count of configured fields per step in step list
